title: The Debt of Tashkent
premise: Wendell Reyes, a financial-crimes investigator who launders her conscience by chasing clean money, discovers that Flight TK-714 from Tashkent has been erased mid-air—passenger manifests, radar logs, everything—while she was the last person to query it. The vanished flight carried a ledger belonging to the Kadyrbayev syndicate, and Wendell's dead father turns out to be its author, his inheritance to her a secret worth killing for. Hunted by the syndicate, compromised by her own agency, and shadowed by a defector from the plane, Wendell must decide whether to sell the ledger to the highest bidder or detonate it publicly. She chooses exposure, trading her father's secret—and her own safety—for justice outside the law, releasing the ledger to the world as the syndicate's empire begins to burn.
about_author: V. M. Ishikawa is the pen name of a former compliance auditor who spent a decade tracing money through Central Asian corridors before walking away to write. They live between cities, keeping—as their protagonists do—one bag always packed.
